input.command: $p = 'dsh-eval-([0-9a-f]{10})'; Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match $p } | ForEach-Object { [void]($_.CommandLine -match $p); "$($_.ProcessId) $($_.Name) $($Matches[1]) $([math]::Round($_.WorkingSetSize/1MB))MB" }; foreach ($n in 'chrome','brave','OneDrive.Sync.Service') { $c = Get-Process $n -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object WorkingSet64 -Sum; if ($c.Count) { "$n $([math]::Round($c.Sum/1MB))MB" } }; "free $([math]::Round((Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem).FreePhysicalMemory/1024))MB"
input.description: Check memory users during low-RAM alert
